title: Draw-Things-60s-Showcase
global_style: cinematic 35mm documentary realism, natural color, detailed textures, no text, no captions

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A quiet mountain lake at blue hour, glassy water reflecting snow-covered peaks, a small wooden pier in the foreground, mist hovering over the surface
scenes.video_prompt: Mist slowly drifts across a quiet mountain lake at blue hour, reflections ripple gently, camera performs a slow forward push from the wooden pier toward the mountains
scenes.camera: slow forward dolly, wide establishing shot, 35mm lens
scenes.motion: soft water ripples, drifting mist, subtle dawn light change
scenes.style: realistic alpine landscape, calm cinematic atmosphere

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A narrow rain-soaked city street at night, neon signs reflecting on wet pavement, a cyclist paused at the end of the alley, steam rising from a street vent
scenes.video_prompt: Neon reflections shimmer across wet pavement in a narrow city street at night, steam rises from a street vent, a cyclist slowly rolls through the alley
scenes.camera: low angle tracking shot along the street, 50mm lens
scenes.motion: rain falling, reflections shimmering, steam curling upward, slow bicycle movement
scenes.style: photoreal urban night, vivid neon, cinematic contrast

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A sunlit desert highway stretching toward distant red rock mesas, heat haze above the road, a classic convertible parked on the shoulder
scenes.video_prompt: Heat haze waves above a sunlit desert highway, the camera slowly glides past a classic convertible toward distant red rock mesas, dust moves lightly in the wind
scenes.camera: smooth lateral tracking shot, wide 35mm anamorphic
scenes.motion: heat shimmer, light dust movement, slow camera glide
scenes.style: warm western road film look, realistic desert sunlight

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A cozy workshop table covered with brass gears, small tools, sketches, and a half-built mechanical clock, warm lamp light illuminating floating dust
scenes.video_prompt: A half-built mechanical clock ticks softly on a cozy workshop table, brass gears turn slowly, warm lamp light catches floating dust as the camera pushes in
scenes.camera: macro push-in over the table, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: tiny gears turning, dust drifting, warm light flicker
scenes.style: tactile handcrafted realism, warm cinematic macro detail

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A peaceful coastal cliff at sunset, tall grass moving in the wind, waves crashing far below, golden sunlight breaking through scattered clouds
scenes.video_prompt: Tall grass bends in the coastal wind on a sunset cliff, waves crash far below, clouds drift as golden light spills across the ocean, camera slowly rises to reveal the horizon
scenes.camera: slow crane up, wide cinematic landscape shot
scenes.motion: grass swaying, waves rolling, clouds drifting, sunlight shifting
scenes.style: natural coastal realism, golden hour, calm cinematic ending
